text: OVERDOSAGE AND TOXICITY The risk of systemic toxicity on Boric Acid depends on the concentration used, route of administration, age of the patient, skin condition, and duration of exposure. The fatal adult dose is about 20 grams or 0.1-0.5 mg/kg taken orally. The intravaginal administration of Boric Acid, 0.025 mg per suppository is safe to use and expected not to pose risk of systemic toxicity at the prescribed dosage.
